arguments.name: latency-test-ambiguous
arguments.body: Latency test results are inconclusive. Rate limiting explains the daytime spikes but not the overnight spikes. Cold starts have the opposite fit. Neither hypothesis explains the full pattern, and available instrumentation cannot distinguish them. Cause remains unresolved pending instrumentation that can separate provider rate limiting from our cold starts.
